issues.issue: The printed label isn't other/miscellaneous. It mixes capital facility (connection) charges with capital reimbursements, no breakdown is printed, and the Statement of Activities (p2) shows it as Capital Grants and Contributions. FY2024 also records it as other, so the years match. A person may want a specific category, e.g. a capital contributions/charges category. The same applies to detail[60] Water 10,360,888 and detail[76] Sewer 2,109,807 (p18).

This is a mixed label. Utility hookup (connection) fees are usually charges for services, and the Statement of Activities (p2) counts all operating revenue (9,054,683) in Charges for Services. licenses and permits is defensible but debatable. The same applies to detail[58] Water 92,579 and detail[74] Sewer 1,788,040 (p18).
